verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents an Answers endpoint that researches a question on the live web and returns JSON with source URLs, which gives structured, citable output (docs-35). Its schema-shaped extraction adds grounding, coverage, and freshness controls (docs-4, docs-21). However, nothing documents a named preset or profile tuned for research agents; users instead pick an endpoint and set its parameters. Missing for 10: an explicit research-agent preset configuration, detail on the citation format or granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
